style: cel-shaded toon illustration, thick dark ink contour, flat theatrical stage lighting, carnival
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every mechanical sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); the symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing gets mirrored by accident. Sprites are drawn on whatever backdrop the model likes because the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about background colour. chip_base, plate_panel, stage_floor and stage_drape are 9-sliced in their .meta, so their prompts ask for a flat centre and a uniform border that survives stretching. No prompt contains the app name, and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1).
